scope: Fixed Mini/Mega Gnar: ordinary attack identity, range and level-scaled form stats. Rage, transformations, transformation healing, Hyper and ability casts excluded.

references.author: Riot Games patch notes, reproduced verbatim by Surrender at 20
references.supports: Mini attack range endpoints 400 and 500 at levels 1 and 18. The current client calculation supplies the 100-unit linear level increase. Original Riot URL now redirects to the news index.

references.author: Riot Pwyff patch notes, reproduced by Nerfplz
references.supports: Mini passive attack speed was folded into the 6% growth stat. Mega stat increases use the nonlinear stat growth progression. Current values come from retained 16.19 records, not historical values.
Base movement speed 335 and Mini bonus movement speed 0 to 20.
Mega passive base AD was corrected to match the tooltip; use the named passive additions instead of conflicting GnarBig root AD/resistance values.

discrepancies: GnarBig root AD growth 5.5 conflicts with Mini 3.2 plus named passive 2.5; effective Mega growth is 5.7.
GnarBig root armor/MR 36/33 conflict with Mini 32/30 plus named passive 3.5 each; use effective 35.5/33.5.
Do not add TotalAS tooltip values on top of the already-folded 6% Mini attack-speed growth.
TotalAttackRange only supplies the 0-to-100 level increase; the 400 baseline is a reviewed semantic rule from Riot patch 6.13.
